name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.7 degrees north of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 11 times in 3 visits over 13 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 24 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 13 hours starting 2025-10-10, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 3.56 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
